Setup instructions

Follow the practical guide

Original installation instructions

  1. Codex CLI route: In your website project, review the README and run npx ui-ux-pro-max-cli init --ai codex for Codex.
  2. Reload Codex; invoke $ui-ux-pro-max with your audience and visual references. Expect design guidance, not finished components.
Check before keeping it

Ask for one small result, inspect the output and permissions, and confirm it suits your app. If it fails, undo your changes and return to your original project.
